new_candidates.body:
Thank you for sharing your work on [RoboCasa](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.02523)!

I am Lingdong from the [WorldBench](https://github.com/worldbench) team and a co-author of [Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.22748) and [Quo Vadis, World Modeling?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02713). 

We maintain the accompanying [Agentic World Modeling reading list](https://github.com/matrix-agent/awesome-agentic-world-modeling) and [Quo Vadis reading list](https://github.com/worldbench/awesome-agentic-world-model).

Your work is already included in the Quo Vadis reading list under **Dynamics Proxy**. We would welcome any corrections or updated resources, such as paper versions, project pages, code, or checkpoints, as well as suggestions for accurate coverage of your work in either survey. Please feel free to open a pull request to update the existing entry, or reply here with suggestions.

Thank you for sharing your work with the community!

Lingdong\
From the [WorldBench](https://github.com/worldbench) team
new_candidates.title: Invitation to review the RoboCasa entry in the Quo Vadis reading list
